name: iot-managed-integrations
description: Managed integrations is a feature of AWS IoT Device Management that enables developers to quickly build innovative IoT solutions.

subcommands.name: create-account-association
subcommands.description: Creates a new account association via the destination id.

subcommands.name: create-cloud-connector
subcommands.description: Creates a C2C (cloud-to-cloud) connector.

subcommands.name: create-connector-destination
subcommands.description: Create a connector destination for connecting a cloud-to-cloud (C2C) connector to the customer's Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-credential-locker
subcommands.description: Create a credential locker.

subcommands.name: create-destination
subcommands.description: Create a notification destination such as Kinesis Data Streams that receive events and notifications from Managed integrations.

subcommands.name: create-event-log-configuration
subcommands.description: Set the event log configuration for the account, resource type, or specific resource.

subcommands.name: create-managed-thing
subcommands.description: Creates a managed thing.

subcommands.name: create-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a notification configuration.

subcommands.name: create-ota-task
subcommands.description: Create an over-the-air (OTA) task to target a device.

subcommands.name: create-ota-task-configuration
subcommands.description: Create a configuraiton for the over-the-air (OTA) task.

subcommands.name: create-provisioning-profile
subcommands.description: Create a provisioning profile for executing device provisioning flows.

subcommands.name: delete-account-association
subcommands.description: Remove a third-party account association for an end user.

subcommands.name: delete-cloud-connector
subcommands.description: Delete a cloud connector.

subcommands.name: delete-connector-destination
subcommands.description: Delete a connector destination linked to a cloud-to-cloud (C2C) connector.

subcommands.name: delete-credential-locker
subcommands.description: Delete a credential locker.

subcommands.name: delete-destination

subcommands.name: delete-event-log-configuration
subcommands.description: Delete an event log configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-managed-thing

subcommands.name: delete-notification-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a notification configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-ota-task
subcommands.description: Delete the over-the-air (OTA) task.

subcommands.name: delete-ota-task-configuration
subcommands.description: Delete the over-the-air (OTA) task configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-provisioning-profile
subcommands.description: Delete a provisioning profile.

subcommands.name: deregister-account-association
subcommands.description: Deregister an account association from a managed thing.

subcommands.name: get-account-association
subcommands.description: Get an account association for an Amazon Web Services account linked to a customer-managed destination.

subcommands.name: get-cloud-connector
subcommands.description: Get configuration details for a cloud connector.

subcommands.name: get-connector-destination
subcommands.description: Get connector destination details linked to a cloud-to-cloud (C2C) connector.

subcommands.name: get-credential-locker
subcommands.description: Get information on an existing credential locker

subcommands.name: get-custom-endpoint
subcommands.description: Returns the IoT managed integrations custom endpoint.

subcommands.name: get-default-encryption-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the default encryption configuration for the Amazon Web Services account in the default or specified region.

subcommands.name: get-destination
subcommands.description: Gets a destination by name.

subcommands.name: get-device-discovery
subcommands.description: Get the current state of a device discovery.

subcommands.name: get-event-log-configuration
subcommands.description: Get an event log configuration.

subcommands.name: get-hub-configuration
subcommands.description: Get a hub configuration.

subcommands.name: get-managed-thing
subcommands.description: Get details of a managed thing including its attributes and capabilities.

subcommands.description: Get the capabilities for a managed thing using the device ID.

subcommands.name: get-managed-thing-certificate

subcommands.description: Get the connectivity status of a managed thing.

subcommands.name: get-schema-version
